actions.code: (() => { const clean = (value) => String(value || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const isBadObjectText = (value) => /^\[object\s+[^\]]+\]$/i.test(clean(value)); const safeText = (value) => { const text = clean(value); return isBadObjectText(text) ? '' : text; }; const textOf = (selector) => { const el = document.querySelector(selector); return el ? safeText(el.textContent) : ''; }; const pathParts = window.location.pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean); const id = pathParts.length > 0 ? pathParts[0] : String('{{mangaId}}'); const title = textOf('div.article-header h1') || textOf('div.article-header') || textOf('h1') || ('Kiutaku #' + id); const tags = []; const seenTags = []; Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('div.article-tags a.tag > span')).forEach((el) => { const tag = safeText(el.textContent).replace(/^#+/, ''); const tagKey = tag.toLowerCase(); if (tag && seenTags.indexOf(tagKey) < 0) { seenTags.push(tagKey); tags.push(tag); } }); const dateText = textOf('div.article-info small'); const firstImg = document.querySelector('div.article-fulltext img[src]'); const coverRaw = firstImg ? (firstImg.getAttribute('src') || '') : ''; let cover = ''; try { cover = coverRaw ? new URL(coverRaw, location.href).href : ''; } catch (e) { cover = coverRaw; } const pageCount = document.querySelectorAll('div.article-fulltext img[src]').length; const descriptionParts = []; if (dateText) descriptionParts.push(dateText); if (tags.length > 0) descriptionParts.push('Tags: ' + tags.join(', ')); if (pageCount > 0) descriptionParts.push('Pages on first chapter: ' + pageCount); return JSON.stringify({ id: id, title: title, cover: cover, author: '', status: 'completed', description: descriptionParts.join('\n'), genre: tags.join(', '), url: id }); })();

(() => { const clean = (value) => String(value || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const currentParts = window.location.pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean); const currentId = currentParts.length > 0 ? currentParts[0] : String('{{mangaId}}'); const nav = document.querySelector('nav.pagination'); const links = nav ? Array.from(nav.querySelectorAll('a')) : []; const seen = []; const chapters = []; links.forEach((a) => { const label = clean(a.textContent); const href = a.getAttribute('href') || ''; let id = ''; try { const url = new URL(href, location.href); const parts = url.pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean); id = (parts.length > 0 ? parts[0] : currentId) + url.search; } catch (e) {} if (id && seen.indexOf(id) < 0) { seen.push(id); chapters.push({ id: id, title: 'Page ' + (label || String(chapters.length + 1)), url: id, publishTime: '' }); } }); if (chapters.length === 0) { chapters.push({ id: currentId, title: 'Page 1', url: currentId, publishTime: '' }); } return JSON.stringify(chapters); })();

(() => { const pages = []; const images = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('div.article-fulltext img[src]')); images.forEach((img, index) => { const src = img.getAttribute('src') || ''; let imageUrl = src; try { imageUrl = src ? new URL(src, location.href).href : ''; } catch (e) {} if (imageUrl) { pages.push({ index: index, imageUrl: imageUrl, width: Number(img.getAttribute('width') || 0), height: Number(img.getAttribute('height') || 0) }); } }); return JSON.stringify({ pages: pages, totalPages: pages.length, hasNextPage: false, nextPageUrl: null }); })();
